items.summaryOriginal: Amazon Quick brings structured and unstructured data together in one experience. In this post, you connect Amazon S3 as a knowledge base, enrich a dataset, build a Space, and create a custom chat agent that answers business questions across both data types through a single conversational interface.

items.title: ServiceNow تبادل الرمز المميز نيابة عن مع Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
items.titleOriginal: ServiceNow on-behalf-of token exchange with Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
items.summary: تعلم كيفية تكوين Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway لتبادل الرمز المميز (OBO) نيابة عن Microsoft Entra ID، حتى يتمكن وكيل الذكاء الاصطناعي من الاتصال بـ ServiceNow REST API
items.summaryOriginal: Learn how to configure Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway for an on-behalf-of (OBO) token exchange with Microsoft Entra ID, so an AI agent can call the ServiceNow REST API while preserving the calling user's identity. AgentCore Gateway performs the exchange natively, with no interceptor Lambda or custom code.
